verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs say Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that "boot in under a second" and "scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives." They also describe fast-launching VMs managed through a REST API and the `fly scale` command for horizontal scaling. Community reports of flaky deploys and stuck instances lower confidence but do not directly contradict the boot-time or scale claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of sub-second boot times, in-depth docs on autoscaling mechanics and limits at the tens-of-thousands scale.
